decisions.reason: The policy-document PDF and new-tab decision does not alter Cognito branding; the Sign In background clause confirms the existing background treatment.
Temporary PDF delivery for Cookie and Privacy documents does not change the shell elements required for the Sign In and Account Provisioning pages.
The separate Tenant Launch Flow background change is already represented in this Requirement, while the policy-document delivery decision does not affect provisioning styling.
The optional prototype-code deliverable remains limited to Sign In and Account Provisioning and is unchanged by the policy-document format.
The footer retains its policy menu links unchanged; their PDF destinations and new-tab behavior are independently represented by the policy-access Requirement.
The policy-document format and link behavior have no effect on webfont files or metadata.
Opening policy PDFs in separate tabs does not modify the landing-page section order, copy plan, or How It Works sequence.
The policy-document access change does not alter any design-token specification.
Temporarily serving policy documents as PDFs does not change the shared dark theme for website pages.
Policy-document delivery and navigation behavior do not affect the admin workspace shell styling requirement.
The panel-layout discussion is a separate clause already represented in this Requirement; the policy-document change does not alter panel navigation.
The policy-document format and new-tab behavior do not affect landing-page hero presentation.
